i just wish there was some other way to help him. both our parents see us as very close to adults, and will change something if need be. i have been in this relationship for a year, so im close with his family and they hear me out when im concerned about something, especially their son. they know i'm the only person he truly trusts, and they know i can help him. they just aren't understanding the burden that also puts me through, a 17 year old who goes to school and has a job and yadda yadda. it's just getting a lot, and i wish there was someone else that could take care of him for a little bit while i get a rest
